bootstrap.method: resample the five trained folds, then biological samples within each sampled fold

claim_boundaries: Cosine similarity alone does not establish biological or task preservation.
A near-zero retrieval contrast is not described as an improvement.
No slide-independent sign-flip p-values are reported.
Condition associations do not establish that scanner suppression causes retention changes.
No cell is called universally optimal; the stable operating region is a parameter-free intersection of fold-specific Pareto sets.
Results apply only to the registered canine SCC DINOv2 paired-acquisition protocol.
The analysis cannot establish pure biological factors, complete scanner invariance, information-theoretic independence, clinical utility, causality, or universal capacity or regularization laws.

condition_effects.dimension_contrasts: each dimension minus the 64-dimensional reference, marginal over all three registered cross-covariance weights
condition_effects.interaction_contrasts: difference-in-differences: (dimension minus 64) at weight 0.05 or 0.20 minus the same dimension contrast at weight 0.0
condition_effects.weight_contrasts: weight 0.05 or 0.20 minus weight 0.0, marginal over all six registered dimensions

fold_stability.stable_operating_region: intersection of the non-dominated condition sets computed independently in all five folds; no tolerance or post hoc score weights

metrics.interpretation: linear scanner recoverability in the biological branch
linear scanner recoverability in the acquisition branch
held-out canine tissue-category probe accuracy in the biological branch
held-out canine tissue-category recoverability in the acquisition branch
average paired-view cosine; never evidence of biological preservation by itself
worst scanner-pair cosine; never evidence of biological preservation by itself
average held-out same-region top-1 retrieval across scanner pairs
worst scanner-pair held-out same-region top-1 retrieval
descriptive held-out RMS standardized cross-covariance between branches; not independence

point_estimate: mean biological-sample value after averaging the five optimization seeds within fold, condition, and sample

probe_protocol.checkpoint: final epoch only; no test-based checkpoint selection
probe_protocol.fit_rows: all non-test rows in the registered fold
probe_protocol.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only on non-test probe rows
probe_protocol.sample_metric: mean row-level correctness within the held-out biological sample

seed_averaging: average seeds within fold, dimension, cross-covariance weight, and biological sample before inferential summaries

suppression_retention_association.method: within each fold, Spearman association across the 18 seed-averaged condition means
suppression_retention_association.statement_boundary: descriptive association only; no causal wording or p-value

tissue_or_task_retention_metrics: canine tissue-category probe accuracy and same-region retrieval are available; clinical, diagnostic, patient-outcome, and external human-task metrics are unavailable and are not inferred
